items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: pain and anguish over the brutality of the George Floyd situation, the murder of this man

ctx.x: Can you share what you are hearing?

Dissatisfaction with the president. They like to talk about that. Fear about the next coming months, what it might bring and pain and anguish over the brutality of the George Floyd situation, the murder of this man, you know, and the consequences of that, and the protests. A lot of fear. I think the whole world is looking at America with what’s next. And just hoping that we come out of this with some positivity and some leadership. We need leadership. That’s what I feel. That’s what’s really lacking you know.…

segments of it, you know, I feel like sometimes Andrew Cuomo in New York has done a good job at certain things. You know there are bits of good leadership, there are good cops shining through. There are people trying to lead the way and show positivity. We just need so much more of it.
